answer: An operator running 104 keys thus pays for 104 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the sonnet quota and the dawn admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the anchor ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 9 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
